metadata.description: Mella's curated marketplace of Claude Code plugins

plugins.name: mella
plugins.description: Mella's collection of productivity tools for Claude Code

plugins.name: grain
plugins.description: Automatic, always-on cross-session memory. Quietly records what you did and decided in each project, then recalls it at the start of every session.

plugins.name: git-diff
plugins.description: A mod that shows uncommitted git changes above the prompt: files changed, green added and red removed counts, and a GitHub-style bar.

plugins.name: session-stats
plugins.description: A Claude Code mod that shows the model, context fill and rate-limit usage above the prompt, with a pane that breaks the context window down.

plugins.name: artisan-dev
plugins.description: Runs `php artisan dev` for a Laravel project and manages it from a pane: per-process logs, restart and stop controls, port override, the site link, and a public tunnel whose links it checks.

plugins.name: worktree-ready
plugins.description: Makes a new git worktree of a Laravel app ready with no hands: copy-on-write clones of vendor, node_modules and built assets, a Valet or Herd HTTPS site, and clean-up when you leave.

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: A mod that stops pushes, PRs and raw commits you did not ask for, steers Bash to the right tools, and runs the project's own formatter on each file Claude edits.
